prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1445; do not mention it.)
text:
We have been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes and was sideswiped by another vehicle. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently under medical care.

Please direct all future communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Any statements, requests for information, or settlement discussions should be routed through our firm.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page, within thirty days of receipt of this letter.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, the claim file, adjuster notes, repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.
